svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Containers and Docker, slide 9. Many containers, one file: Docker Compose
svg.desc: Docker Compose: docker compose up -d reads docker-compose.prod.yml and starts five containers (proxy with ports 80 and 443, frontend, certbot, backend, db) on two networks: edge for the proxy, apps and certbot, and the private data network that only the backend and db share; volumes pgdata and letsencrypt keep the data.
svg.text: Docker Compose reads one YAML file and starts our whole stack with one command.
